meta.title: Primitives for raw OCaml block access
meta.body_summary: Extract Flambda2 block index primitives (Read_offset/Write_offset) and expose %raw_field / %set_raw_field for faster unboxed memory access, with tests but still a draft awaiting user-facing wrappers.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code added raw field primitives; reviewer flagged dead code, over-commenting, and missing float record support, PR closed as draft with no merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 630 changed lines across 23 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume. As a draft compiler primitive addition, it remained unmerged, consistent with its draft status and unresolved review comments.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer rtjoa pointed out dead 32-bit code, excessive inline comments, lack of float/mixed record support, and requested additional tests for mixed blocks, float records, arrays, etc.
review_details.performance_claim: Faster field access than Obj.raw_field via unboxed primitives (no numeric claim).
review_details.rejection_signals: Draft PR explicitly stating need for user-facing wrappers before use; reviewer raised multiple correctness and coverage concerns; no approval, closed without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding low-level compiler primitives requires deep knowledge of OCaml runtime, memory model, and architecture specifics; the agent generated plausible code but missed nuanced cases like float record support and 32-bit dead code.

detection_detail.code_reading: Reviewer rtjoa scrutinized the implementation, identifying dead paths, commenting style, and missing test coverage for specific OCaml value layouts (float records, mixed blocks, arrays).

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Basic correctness tests provided, but no performance evidence; reviewer required more test cases for edge cases.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no follow-up fixes.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced Prawfield and Psetrawfield Lambda primitives, translated to Flambda2 Read_offset/Write_offset, for unboxed raw memory access via %raw_field / %set_raw_field. Added simplification, code size estimates, CMM translations, and tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Also touched simplify modules, bytecode binding, and various lambda-support files.
change_trajectory: Initial extraction of Read_offset/Write_offset from block indices PR.
Fixed kind specifications (naked_nativeint instead of any_value).
Added test file raw_field_primitives.ml and later nativeint variant.
Multiple 'Various fixes', 'formatting', and 'Fix mistakes in porting' commits.
Final commit added test reference files.

review_signals.summary: Pointed out that the 32-bit word size check is dead code since the native compiler only supports 64-bit.
Noted that the code is over-commented and suggested avoiding precedent for future AI changes.
Requested additional tests for mixed blocks, float records, bits32/void/vec128 fields, and various array accesses.
Suggested someone else review the to_cmm_primitive.ml changes to avoid self-review.
Forwarded request to implement fexpr support for the block index primitives.
Asked whether float records are supported and suggested documenting the assumptions of the primitives.

collaboration_trajectory: Author opened draft PR with initial primitive extraction.
Several force-pushes and commits added Lambda exposure, kind fixes, tests, formatting, and cleanup.
PR moved to ready for review.
Reviewer rtjoa provided detailed inline feedback on correctness, commenting style, missing tests, and architecture concerns.
No follow-up commits or discussion after review; PR closed without merge.
